name: 60073 · Round Lake, IL
findings: ZIP 60073 (Round Lake) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60073 (Round Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60073 (Round Lake) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
